item.title: The Protection of Journalist Viktoriia Roshchyna under International Humanitarian Law
item.description: Viktoriia Roshchyna, a Ukrainian journalist whose reporting focused on crime, human rights and Russia’s actions in occupied Ukraine, died in Russian captivity.
